name: Stoked Slice's Class Bonus On Attack banishes two fire cards from graveyard to rally allies
notes: Same WARRIOR Class Bonus override as emberslash-discard-draw (Counters['_overrides']['classes']). Stoked Slice is FIRE element, and the starting champion (Spirit of Fire) is already FIRE, so no Subcards lineage patch was needed (unlike conductive-strike-static-counters' ARCANE requirement). The onAttackPrereqs gate additionally requires >= 2 FIRE cards already in the graveyard, so two copies of Cell Handler (pk9xycwz9g, a plain FIRE ally) are seeded there. Stoked Slice is played from hand (2 reserve) and declared as an attack (lands for its base 2 power); the on-attack trigger then offers an MZMULTICHOOSE (min 0, max 2) over the graveyard's fire cards -- selecting both resolves MoveGraveyardSelectionToBanish, which returns 2 and adds the AddGlobalEffects($player, "6wiHKD52Lw_ALLIES") flag (the actual '+1 POWER until end of turn' to allies is a computed buff read off that global effect at power-calculation time, with no independently stored per-ally counter, so it's out of scope beyond the flag itself). A second global effect, CHAMP_DEALT_COMBAT_DMG, is a side effect of combat damage landing at all, not of this card's own ability -- matching the same effect already seen in the pre-existing gleaming-cut-lightweavers-assault fixture.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Attack: You may banish two fire element cards from your graveyard. If you do, allies you control get +1POWER until end of turn.
